avis.texte: Light weight but hydrating. Gives a natural glow finish. Doesn't burn eyes or skin. Not overly fragranced. Have repurchased a couple of times now.
Feels amazing And you get A nice glow. I just started using sun block and love this kind.

Was a total groupie for the original dew glo. The timted was a fail for me (medium is very pink and i needed to mix in blue pigment just to make it not look weird) BUT THIS ONE? its fine if youre not gonna wear any makeup or powder for the day. It pills horrible, smells gross (my bf commented on the scent an hour after application said it smelled like some kinda nut) and if worn too many days in a row, i get pimples. In a pinch, sure. But not worth repurchasing

They reformulated this product and my dryish 54 year old skin can get a tiny bit dry from this. It is fine on it's own to the beach but I can't seem to get it right under makeup. I love all Naturium products though. I use the body wash and lotion.

avis.titre: Not as good as the Dew Glow SPF
avis.texte: I wish i just bought the dew glow moisturizer SPF like usual. I tried this one because it came in a larger size & that was a mistake. It smells sour and leaves a white cast. It also gives a burning sensation which is uncomfortable. Please sell full size dew glow moisturizer SPF ulta😭

I had such high hopes for this sunscreen but it pills and catches dry patches and it's also triggered an eczema breakout on my eyelids. This was the only product that I introduced into my routine. I'm past the return point sadly but I'll be going back to the OG formula from now on.

This sunscreen is very heavy on thr skin. Feels like the heavy white zinc sunscreens. It doesn't leave a white cast. It has a very natural finish. If this was waterproof I would use it more. The lid is a dome shaped, it represents how much product you should use. Fill the lid. I love that part.
They no longer carry the Dew-Glow Moisturizer Mineral SPF 50 for women of color. They used to have a dark shade but now only 2 shades light and lighter. Disappointed

avis.titre: Great sunscreen on my reactive skin
avis.texte: This is very mild and the glow is subtle which I love. It's very hydrating but doesn't upset my skin. It's in my top 3 favorite sunscreens for my face.

I will stick with the original sunscreen. It was hard to rub in, the smell is horrible, it gets sticky throughout the day, and chunk of my skin peeled off. My mother also used it and she had a burning sensation when she applied it. This and their lipgloss are the only never buy again items on my list.

I'm latino and between a 3 and 4 on the Fitzpatrick scale. I've tried several over the counter and professional mineral sunscreens that left a whitecast on my face. Needless to say, I was hesitant to try this sunscreen but SO GLAD I DID! It is a little thick so I add a couple of drops of Vitamin C serum, smooth as butter. AND no whitecast at all!!!! Very impressed with this sunscreen, my search to find the right sunscreen is OVER! Thank you Naturium!!!
Dew-Glow Moisturizer Mineral SPF 50 I absolutely love it! It's an amazing SPF.

I've been using dew glow for years and loved it. Then picked up the mineral dew glow and could not believe how much more I love it. It's so so so good, my skin is so perfectly glowy and it feels amazing. 10/10 sunscreen!

I did not like this new formula as it is not as moisturizering. I really love the original formula and was hoping that with the added ingredients it would be more moisturizering with the added benefits, so i purchased 2 instead of 1 and only 1 of the original. I am very disappointed.
Figured I'd give this mineral sunscreen a try upon ordering the original. What they were asking for the price of one I now have two. It has a slight smell but works as should.
Unfortunately, this left a white cast on me twice (have deep/dark skin). I thought it was my base products but even after minimal products it didn't work.

I love this SPF even more than the original version. It's not as greasy and feels much lighter on the skin. It gives the skin a beautiful glow, but it looks more like a natural radiance than oily skin. For my oily skin, this sunscreen is perfect. It leaves almost no white cast and works beautifully under makeup.
This product has been great in the morning to finalize my routine. It's lightweight and doesn't leave me greasy. Love the 50 SPF!

avis.titre: As an Esti- I say give it a go!
avis.texte: I bought the sunscreen in hopes for a fair price alternative, compared to my previous sunscreen. The glow after applying sunscreen is definitely there! It's not heavy, moderately light weight. I would've given 5 stars but there is a strong smell to the spf when first applied. I tend to go for a no scent spf but I'm letting this spf pass and i will continue to use!! I love this line and with every product I am repurchasing, whether it's the same product or another! They never fail me 😁

Not what I expected. It left a subtle white film on my face after application. Definitely a "unglow/natural" finish once it settles in. Not my cup tea… I will stick with the original Dew Glow Moisturizer.

This is a great quality mineral sunscreen! It blends seamlessly on my skin, leaving no white cast. Formula feels smooth & it gives me sun protection with a little extra glow! Pump applicator works nicely & the packaging is super cute and convenient for taking on-the-go.

I love that Naturium came out with a mineral version of the iconic SPF 50. This sunscreen blends beautifully into the skin and doesn't leave a white cast. It feels super light weight and not oily or greasy. It's perfect for wearing under makeup but also looks beautiful on its own. Not to mention, it's perfect for anyone with acne prone or sensitive skin because it's formulated without harsh chemicals like most SPFs. I'll be using this one all Summer long!

avis.titre: Been using this sunscreen for years
avis.texte: I love the chemical dew glow sunscreen so I had to check out their new mineral sunscreen. I love it! Giving 5 stars because their formula is superb and has never broken me out. But, I wish they used a different component because at the end of every tube I need to cut it open to scoop out the excess. Also, it burns my eyes which is a bummer. Still, formula is great!

I'm happy to report that there's no white cast (on me). I'm range from NC45 to NC50 in MAC. Haven't worn MAC in decades, but it's a shade range most are familiar with. I filled the top of the lid (1/4 teaspoon) and applied. It rubbed in easily and feels very nourishing. The scent is unusual, not at all unpleasant, and one of those scents that seems a bit unfamiliar and strange at first, but then starts to feel comforting. I did have a tiny bit of stinging on my eyelids but I also included my Lotion P50 in my skincare routine. I didn't rub that on my eyelids, but I think while running the SPF on there may have been some residue from the P50 left on my fingertips. I love how my skin feels, all that's left now is to see how it performs in the sun. And I have no doubt that it will perform well.
